All pass, including empty traces and tiny FIBs.

Wait — stress with ntrace=0: does gen.py produce an empty trace file? Yes (text = ''). And nfib=0 → empty FIB. Both work.

Let me now run a larger randomized stress with medium sizes (e.g., 300 FIB records) across more seeds for extra confidence, and also test some specific tricky FIB structures:
- All prefixes with len 64 (adjacent keys).
- Nested prefixes (a full chain /1../64 on the same address).
- Overlapping prefixes with the same hop.
- Prefix at the very top of the address space (ffff:...:/64).
- Prefix covering everything (::/0) plus others.

Let me write a targeted test comparing against the reference for such structured FIBs.

Also let me test a chain FIB: for L in 0..64: "2001:db8:1:2::/L hop_L" → nested prefixes.

And a FIB where many prefixes map to the same normalized key with different lengths.

Let me do that.

arguments.command:
cd /work/tmp && B=/work/submit/planb64 && python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, itertools, random
def w(path, lines): open(path,'w').write(''.join(l+'\n' for l in lines))
cases = {}
# nested chain over all lengths
cases['chain'] = ['2001:db8:1:2::/%d %d' % (L, 100+L) for L in range(0,65)]
# top of space
cases['top'] = ['ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff::/64 7', '::/0 1', 'ffff:ffff:ffff:fffe::/63 9', '8000::/1 5']
# same hop different lengths adjacent
cases['samehop'] = ['2001:db8::/%d 42' % L for L in (32,33,34,48,64)]
# many /64 contiguous
cases['contig'] = ['2001:db8:%x::/64 %d' % (i, i) for i in range(0,256)]
# overlapping /48s with alternating hops
cases['alt'] = ['2001:db8:%x::/48 %d' % (i, i%3) for i in range(0,64)]
# single record
cases['single'] = ['::1/64 0']
# default only
cases['def'] = ['::/0 4294967295']
# v4-embedded and uppercase
cases['styles'] = ['::FFFF:192.168.1.1/64 5', '2001:DB8::/32 6', '0:0:0:0:0:0:0:0/0 7', '2001:0db8:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0001/64 8']
for name, lines in cases.items():
    w('c.fib', lines)
    r = subprocess.run(['python3','ref.py','build','c.fib'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert r.returncode==0, (name, r.stderr)
    p = subprocess.run([B.replace('$B','/work/submit/planb64'),'build','c.fib','c.idx'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if '/work/submit/planb64' != B: pass
    assert p.returncode==0, (name, p.stderr)
    got = open('c.idx').read()
    if got != r.stdout:
        print("MISMATCH", name); print(got); print(r.stdout)
    else:
        print("ok", name, "rows", got.split('\n')[1])
    # trace of interesting keys
    tr = ['::', '::1', '2001:db8::', '2001:db8:1:2::3', '2001:db8:ff::', 'ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff',
          'ffff:ffff:ffff:fffe::', '8000::', '7fff:ffff:ffff:ffff::', '::ffff:192.168.1.1', '2001:db8:1:2:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff']
    w('c.tr', tr)
    rr = subprocess.run(['python3','ref.py','lookup','c.idx','c.tr'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    for mode in (['scalar'], ['batch','1'], ['batch','4'], ['batch','256']):
        pp = subprocess.run(['/work/submit/planb64','lookup','c.idx','c.tr']+mode, capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert pp.returncode==0 and pp.stderr=='', (name, mode, pp.stderr)
        assert pp.stdout == rr.stdout, (name, mode, pp.stdout, rr.stdout)
print("ALL STRUCTURED OK")
EOF
